error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while `xs` still views it

  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `value` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `xs` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `value` without `inout`
